name: PostgreSQL
permissions: CONNECT on selected database, pg_monitor; no application-table writes
setup: Create the dedicated read-only monitoring role with the declared permissions.
Keep endpoint and monitored-service credentials on the collector host in the named environment variables.
Review one service, environment and team with fresh owner or admin proof, then download configuration.
Set PORTHOLE_INGEST_TOKEN to the existing scoped credential on the host; start the unmodified pinned collector.
Inspect collector scraper telemetry and the preset; absent data is Unknown.
